description: Build LumenJS apps, use the Roxyon BaaS, and deploy apps and web projects to Roxyon infrastructure.
name: io.github.bea-technology/roxyon

environmentVariables.description: A roxp_ personal access token (alternative to `roxyon login`). Create one with `roxyon token create`.
environmentVariables.name: ROXYON_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Override the BaaS base URL (default https://www.beaapis.com/1).
environmentVariables.name: ROXYON_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override the console base URL (default https://console.roxyon.com).
environmentVariables.name: ROXYON_CONSOLE_URL
